integrity: The primary open full text was inspected at the IZL distribution functions, the two-stage CEM, the equivalent-time quantile equation, Proposition 2, the multi-step extension, and Figure 1. The parent IZL article was inspected at its hazard and quantile sections, and a reliability review was checked for the general CEM matching principle. The monotonicity proof is analytic and the standalone checker was replayed from its packaged path.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to the inverted Z–Lindley family and cumulative-exposure matching at equal CDF levels.
It classifies instantaneous boundary jumps rather than entire post-switch hazard trajectories.
It does not validate stress-to-parameter extrapolation outside the tested stress levels.
title: Stress increases force upward hazard jumps in the IZL cumulative-exposure model
